title: 第一卷 第11章 闫耀宗这个人，仗义！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

叶龙都怀疑是不是听错了，表情有些呆滞，看着面带微笑的闫耀宗，小声道，“闫耀宗，你真原谅我了？”

“我都没有恨过你，谈什么原谅？”

“敞亮！”叶龙深吸一口气，朝着闫耀宗竖起大拇指，道：“闫耀宗，今儿个我算是彻底服气了。之前是我叶龙班门弄斧了，你这个兄弟，我认了。以后只要你闫耀宗开口，不管啥事情，我叶龙绝无二话。”

闫耀宗脸上笑容依旧，可心里边却很无语。

班门弄斧这个成语，是这么用的嘛？

闫耀宗笑着抬起右手。

“干啥？”叶龙满脸好奇，看着闫耀宗抬起的右手。

闫耀宗嘴角微微抽搐，干啥？老子要跟你握手啊，你这都看不出？

微不可查地摇摇头，闫耀宗也不尴尬，顺势微抬手，落在叶龙的肩膀上，道：“龙哥，昨天我跟振东去镇里，跟人民大饭店那边搭上了关系……”

闫耀宗简单地解释了几句。

“你的意思是，咱们去溪山打野货，再卖给人民大饭店？”叶龙眼珠子一转，往日里，他们也经常把打到的野货，拿到镇里卖。

那都是偷偷摸摸的卖。

现在是1988年，买卖野货，根本就没人管。

但，耐不住老一辈的老思想、老观念，不断地告诫年青一代，私下买卖是投机倒把罪……

所以，在叶龙的观念里，买卖野货，都要偷偷摸摸的，要不然就会被抓去坐牢，甚至是挨枪子。

改革开放初期，遍地都是机遇，可真正能够乘势而起的，却没有多少人。

很大原因就是农村的年轻人，不敢迈出第一步。

听完闫耀宗的解释，叶龙皱着眉，低声道，“耀宗，你这么大模大样的做买卖，不会出事儿吧？”

闫耀宗更加无语了，就连叶龙这种胆大包天的人，都害怕做生意……

“龙哥，我认识镇长！”闫耀宗没说什么大道理。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ye Long doubted whether he heard it wrong, his expression was a little dull, he looked at Yan Yaozong who was smiling, and whispered, "Yan Yaozong, have you really forgive me?"

"I've never hated you, so why forgive me?"

"Open up!" Ye Long took a deep breath, gave a thumbs up to Yan Yaozong, and said, "Yan Yaozong, I am completely convinced today. Before, I, Ye Long, was the master of the job, and I recognize you as my brother. From now on, as long as you, Yan Yaozong, speak, no matter what happens, I, Ye Long, will never say anything."

Yan Yaozong still had a smile on his face, but he was speechless in his heart.

Is this the idiom used in the class?

Yan Yaozong raised his right hand with a smile.

"What are you doing?" Ye Long looked at Yan Yaozong's raised right hand with curiosity on his face.

The corners of Yan Yaozong's mouth twitched slightly, what are you doing?I want to shake hands with you, can’t you tell?

Shaking his head slightly, Yan Yaozong was not embarrassed. He raised his hand slightly and landed on Ye Long's shoulder, saying: "Brother Long, Zhendong and I went to town yesterday and established a relationship with the People's Hotel..."

Yan Yaozong briefly explained a few words.

"You mean, let's go to Xishan to hunt wild animals and sell them to the People's Hotel?" Ye Long's eyes rolled. In the past, they often took the wild animals they caught and sold them in the town.

Those are all sold secretly.

It's 1988 now, and no one cares about the buying and selling of wild animals.

However, I cannot bear the old ideas and concepts of the older generation, and constantly warn the younger generation that private trading is speculation and a sin...

Therefore, in Ye Long's view, buying and selling wild goods must be done secretly, otherwise you will be arrested and imprisoned, or even shot.

In the early days of reform and opening up, opportunities were everywhere, but not many people could really take advantage of them.

The big reason is that young people in rural areas dare not take the first step.

After listening to Yan Yaozong's explanation, Ye Long frowned and whispered, "Yao Zong, if you do business in such a big way, nothing will happen, right?"

Yan Yaozong was even more speechless. Even a bold man like Ye Long was afraid of doing business...

"Brother Long, I know the mayor!" Yan Yaozong said nothing.
